questions.text: «needn't have V3» va «didn't need to V1» qanday farqlanadi?
options: needn't have — qildi, lekin keraksiz edi; didn't need to — kerak emas edi (qilmadi ham)
questions.explanation: Bu B2 ning eng nozik modal farqlaridan biri.

questions.text: «You could have told me!» qanday ohang beradi?
questions.explanation: could have V3 — imkon bor edi, lekin ishlatilmadi.
I would have come, but I was ill.
should've = should have — talaffuz o'xshashligi chalg'itadi.

questions.text: Modal perfectdan keyin qaysi shakl keladi?
questions.explanation: Doim have + V3: gone, done, come (went, did, came emas).
be likely to ~70%; unlikely to — dargumon.

questions.text: «had better» dan keyin qanday fe'l keladi?
questions.explanation: Inkor: 'd better NOT — «not» «better» dan keyin.

questions.text: «I was supposed to call» nimani anglatadi?
options: Qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak edi, lekin qilmadim
questions.explanation: be supposed to — kutilgan yoki qoidaga ko'ra bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsa.
needn't go = don't need to go — ma'nosi bir xil, shakli boshqa.
had better va needn't esa «to» siz keladi — shu farqni yodda tuting.
Zamon «be» da ko'rsatiladi, V3 o'zgarmaydi.

questions.text: «The house ___ built now» (hozir qurilyapti) — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous passive: is/are being + V3.

questions.text: «It ___ have been stolen» — modal perfect passiv qanday tuziladi?
questions.explanation: should have been done, must have been stolen.

options: Bajaruvchi noma'lum/muhim emas yoki xolis ohang kerak bo'lganda
questions.explanation: Urg'uni natijaga yoki obyektga qaratish uchun ham.
by — bajaruvchi; with — asbob; of — material.
Gerund passiv: being + V3. Infinitiv passiv: to be + V3.
Perfekt infinitiv passiv: to have been + V3 — oldingi voqea uchun.

questions.text: «Having been warned, he left» — bu qanday shakl?
questions.explanation: having been + V3 — oldin sodir bo'lgan passiv harakat.
needs + V-ing = needs to be + V3 — norasmiy passiv qolip.

questions.text: «got married, got promoted» — bu qanday passiv?
questions.explanation: get-passiv: kutilmagan/yoqimsiz (got fired), holat o'zgarishi, refleksiv (get dressed).
I had my car repaired — tuzattirdim (o'zim tuzatmadim).

questions.text: «I cut my hair» va «I had my hair cut» qanday farqlanadi?
options: Birinchisi o'zim kesdim; ikkinchisi sartaroshga oldirdim
questions.explanation: Causative xizmatni boshqa kishi bajarganini ko'rsatadi.

questions.text: «I had my bag stolen» qanday ma'no beradi?
options: Sumkam o'g'irlandi — menga qilingan yoqimsiz hodisa
questions.explanation: Causative yoqimsiz hodisani ham ifodalaydi.
have + sb + V1 (rasmiy) ↔ get + sb + TO + V1 (ko'ndirish).

options: have — neytral/rasmiy; get — norasmiy, harakat ottenkasi bilan
questions.explanation: I had it fixed (neytral) ↔ I got it fixed (norasmiy).

questions.text: «It is said that he is rich» — bu qaysi naqsh?
options: Naqsh A: It + is/was + V3 + that + gap
questions.explanation: Naqsh B: EGA + is/was + V3 + to-infinitive (He is said to be rich).

questions.text: «He is said ___ rich» — bo'shliqqa qaysi shakl?
questions.explanation: Bir vaqtdagi holat uchun to + V1 / to be.

questions.text: Oldingi voqea haqida reporting qanday beriladi?
questions.explanation: He is said to have left — reportingdan oldin sodir bo'lgan.
Fe'llar: say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider, allege, understand, estimate.
It is rumoured that... / He is rumoured to be...

questions.text: Reported speechda nechta asosiy o'zgarish bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: this→that, these→those, here→there, now→then.
can→could, may→might, will→would; must (xulosa) esa o'zgarmaydi.
Ular allaqachon «orqaga surilgan» shakllar.

options: say odam olmaydi — tell me yoki say to me
questions.explanation: tell + SB (odam shart) ↔ say (odamsiz yoki «to» bilan).

options: Umumiy haqiqat, hozir rost, reporting fe'l hozirgi zamonda, conditional/wish
questions.explanation: He said the Earth is round — hali ham rost.

title: Test — O'zlashtirma savol va reporting fe'llar

questions.text: «He asked where did I live» — bu nega xato?
options: O'zlashtirma savolda darak tartibi: where I lived
questions.explanation: do/does/did o'zlashtirma savolda ishlatilmaydi.
She asked if I liked it.

questions.text: «offer, promise, refuse, agree, threaten» qaysi naqsh bilan?
questions.explanation: He offered to help. She refused to answer.

questions.text: «advise, warn, remind, persuade» qaysi naqsh bilan?
questions.explanation: He warned me not to go — inkor «not to» bilan.

questions.text: «admit, claim, deny, insist» qaysi naqsh bilan?
questions.explanation: say, admit, explain, claim, deny, insist + that + gap.
Defining — that mumkin; non-defining — faqat who/which/whose/where.
My brother who lives in London ≠ My brother, who lives in London,

questions.text: «the man who I met him» — bu nega xato?
questions.explanation: Relative olmoshi allaqachon obyekt vazifasini bajaradi.

questions.text: Defining clauseda obyekt olmoshini tushirish mumkinmi?
questions.explanation: Ega olmoshi esa tushmaydi: the man who called.
where (joy), when (vaqt), why (sabab), whose (egalik).
